basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Lead AI Engineer | Production Agent Systems | Technical Direction & Mentoring
basics.summary: Lead engineer who sets technical direction across multiple concurrent AI initiatives, not just one project end to end. At LumApps I architect production multi-agent systems (LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP tool servers) with eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), and on-call ownership, so regressions get caught before customers see them. At Beekeeper I owned architecture across five production systems at once (Employee Referral, Templater, Forms, Manager Hub, Artifacts) while running observability and on-call for 10M+ users, and built the hiring pipeline for an AI engineering team that now ships independently. 13+ years building production software; every system I design has an evaluation loop and a metric attached, not just a demo.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers (agent-to-tool integration) and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems, catching regressions before they reach customers.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes, with a freshness layer that flags stale facts and grounds RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owned architecture across multiple concurrent production systems, ran observability and on-call for a platform used by millions, and built and mentored the AI engineering team.
highlights: Owned architectural design across five concurrent production systems at once (Artifacts, Forms, Employee Referral, Templater, Manager Hub), keeping each robust and modular by design while initiatives moved in parallel.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.
Acting hiring manager for AI engineering roles. Hired for craft and curiosity, mentored engineers who now lead features independently, raising the technical bar for the team.
Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting for everything the team shipped.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live production test for autonomous systems.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

highlights: Take my own products from zero to production end to end: multi-agent systems, RAG grounding, eval pipelines, and observability, the same playbook I bring to any engagement.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families, replacing spreadsheets and expensive advisors. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built an AI-native MVP: vision models turn inspection photos into structured records; LLM agents turn those records into marketing-ready listings.
highlights: Vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos; LLM agents turn those records into multilingual, marketing-ready listings end to end, zero copy-paste from photo to published listing.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Lead AI Engineer on the agent platform team, building the next generation of legal AI agents. Sets technical architecture and direction across the team's highest-priority initiatives (core agent infrastructure, internal tooling, production reliability), moving fluidly between initiatives rather than owning one fixed workstream. Architects production AI agent systems on modern LLM APIs, agent SDKs, and orchestration/runtime infrastructure; designs agent observability and evaluation practices (tracing, automated evals, quality/drift detection) to catch regressions before customers; advances progressive/feature-flagged rollout and earlier-stage quality signals; drives cross-cutting design reviews and RFCs/ADRs; mentors and raises the technical bar for a senior engineering team using AI-native, agentic development practices; partners with product and engineering leadership on architecture and sequencing. Required: extensive production software architecture experience including hands-on AI/LLM/agentic systems (not just classical ML); direct experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks/SDKs, or agent-to-tool integration protocols; track record setting technical direction across multiple concurrent initiatives; strong backend fundamentals (distributed systems, service architecture, cloud infrastructure); production reliability and observability experience; mentoring senior engineers; comfort with high autonomy on a fast-moving, senior-heavy, AI-native team. Preferred: developer-facing platforms/plugin/integration ecosystems; progressive delivery at scale (feature flagging, phased rollout, blue/green); elite delivery practices and DORA-style metrics; managed agent runtime infrastructure (e.g. AWS Bedrock AgentCore); legal/regulated/professional-services domain a plus but not required.
